cover_letter:
Dear Foxelli Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the CRO Specialist position at Foxelli. As a digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and analytics, I am drawn to your mission of building products customers love and a team that enjoys the process. Your emphasis on experimentation, learning, and meaningful work resonates with my own approach.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained practical experience in optimizing client websites for organic visibility. I conduct keyword research, write targeted content, and manage WordPress sites, all while tracking performance using tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs. This data-driven mindset is directly applicable to CRO, where understanding user behavior and test results is crucial.

My personal project, mirook.com, has been a sandbox for experimentation. I designed and built the site, implemented structured data (JSON-LD), and ran iterative SEO/GEO audits to improve its search health. This hands-on experience taught me to form hypotheses, test changes, and measure outcomes—skills essential for planning and running split tests.

I am comfortable collaborating with designers and developers, as I have done at Episto and ViviDoctor, where I worked as a front-end developer. I understand the importance of clear communication and teamwork in executing tests effectively.

I am eager to bring my analytical skills, curiosity, and ownership mindset to Foxelli. I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your e-commerce brands, driving improvements in conversion rate, AOV, and profitability. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can add value to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
